_help: Your races for the race-week fuelling view on the Nutrition tab.
Copy this file to content/races.json and edit it there (races.json stays out of git).
date: race day as YYYY-MM-DD. name: anything you like. distance_km: race distance.
21 km or longer: carb loading on the two days before, view opens 7 days before.
Shorter: a carb-rich day before, view opens 3 days before.
